canonical_benchmark_verification.scope: Canonical C5G7 UMMU reference arrangement only
canonical_benchmark_verification.objective: Minimize the absolute discrepancy between the independently replicated mean k_eff and the selected published reference value; separately compare a benchmark-compatible spatial fission-rate/power distribution.

reference.source: OECD/NEA C5G7 benchmark reference cited in reports/physical_simulator_validation.md

canonical_benchmark_verification.uncertainty_rule: For replicated mean k_eff, use the across-seed sample standard deviation divided by sqrt(n) as the empirical standard error of the mean; combine with the cited reference standard uncertainty in quadrature. Report within-run Monte Carlo standard deviations separately. With only three seeds this remains a provisional screen, not a strong uncertainty calibration.
nonclaims: Passing these internal thresholds is not official OECD/NEA benchmark acceptance.
A close k_eff alone does not validate geometry, material definitions, boundary conditions, or spatial response.
Historical production/smoke results using log-spaced energy boundaries are not valid evidence for the standard C5G7 benchmark.

six_layout_design_study.scope: Six enumerated four-position arrangements with exactly two UO2 and two MOX assemblies; this is a separate design formulation, not the legacy burnup-state QUBO.

decision_objective_template.name: minimize_assembly_integrated_fission_rate_peaking_factor
decision_objective_template.definition: R_a is the integrated fission tally for fuel assembly a, calculated from the documented 51x51 mesh-to-assembly mapping.
decision_objective_template.interpretation: A relative fission-rate shape proxy only; not absolute power in watts and not a safety metric.

hard_constraints: Exactly two UO2 and two MOX assemblies occupy the four fuel positions.
All six candidates use the same pinned geometry/model source, MGXS data, tally definitions, and computational budget within each comparison.
All candidate runs have unique recorded seeds and unique statepoint hashes.
The canonical benchmark model-identity gate must pass before reference-based acceptance claims.
A design-specific acceptable k_eff band must be justified and fixed before ranking; the canonical benchmark reference value must not be applied automatically to noncanonical layouts.
Assembly-level tally normalization and spatial indexing must be independently reviewed before treating F_fission as a physical objective.

uncertainty_and_ranking.ranking_rule: Do not declare a winner when uncertainty intervals for the objective overlap or the acceptance gate is unresolved; increase histories or report the comparison as inconclusive.

six_layout_design_study.current_reportable_output: Descriptive response tables and uncertainty only; no best-layout claim.

legacy_burnup_qubo_mapping.prohibition: Do not map these labels to UO2/MOX enrichment categories or to arbitrary C5G7 layouts.
required_evidence_before_mapping: Operational definition and burnup units for each category.
Irradiation history, power history, cooling time, temperatures, and material density assumptions.
Isotopic number densities for each state, generated by a documented depletion calculation or obtained from a traceable source.
Depletion chain and nuclear-data/cross-section provenance compatible with the transport calculation.
Validation of each material state and explicit mapping from each QUBO position/state to an OpenMC material definition.
Independent review of the physical meaning and limitations of the mapping.
legacy_burnup_qubo_mapping.fallback: Keep the four-variable UO2/MOX placement QUBO as a separate, clearly named study; leave the legacy mapping blocked until evidence exists.

c5g7_specific_candidate_selection_qubo.variable_definition: y_k in {0,1}, one variable per evaluated 2x2 UO2/MOX layout
c5g7_specific_candidate_selection_qubo.feasibility_rule: mean(k_eff) +/- uncertainty_multiplier * between-seed SD(k_eff) must lie entirely inside user-specified [k_eff_min, k_eff_max]
c5g7_specific_candidate_selection_qubo.no_legacy_mapping: This is a new C5G7-specific formulation; it does not map legacy fresh/once_burned/twice_burned variables to UO2/MOX.
